idea: Independent design review service for developers
pain: Developers cannot tell whether their architect is doing good work
v1: An independent design review of one live scheme
channel: Architecture network into developers, plus lenders
verdict: Better buyer than the practices themselves, and her dual credibility is genuinely persuasive here.

why.distribution: Developers are one hop from her architecture network and adjacent to her finance network.
why.demand: Inferred; developers rarely commission independent design review today.
why.fmf: An architect who can also argue the commercial case is exactly who a developer should want.
why.defensibility: The dual credential is genuinely scarce.
why.leverage: Bespoke per scheme with site visits.
why.ceiling: £4.5k x 44 reviews = £198k, an unreachable volume for solo bespoke work.

ceiling_arithmetic: £4.5k x 44 reviews = £198k. Forty-four site-based reviews is impossible part-time and the behaviour does not yet exist. Realistic: 8-10 = £36-45k.
carries: Aimed at a buyer with actual money, unlike most of this cluster, and a scarce dual credential.
kills: Fee too low for the effort, and developers do not currently buy independent design review.
test: Ask two developers whether they would pay to have their architect's work independently reviewed.
test_fail: They say that is what their project manager is for.
